bibl.title: Archives, Innovation, and the Neomorphic Cyclops.
bibl.seg: Anatole Mori, Archives, Innovation, and the Neomorphic Cyclops.
bibl.note: Offers a new interpretation of Stesichorus' influence on the portrayal of the Cyclops in Theocritus' Idylls 6 and 11: Stesichorus' sympathetic treatment of Geryon provides a model for the reinvention of Polyphemus.
